name: Gabatarwa ga Deep Learning da Neural Networks
objectives: Ba tare da rubutattun bayanai ba, bayanin mene ne deep learning da ambaton irin bayanan da ya fi aiki da su, kuna ambaton layers da ke koyon tsari daga misalai, da aƙalla irin bayanai biyu da suka dace
Idan aka ba ku inputs, weights, bias da ReLU na neuron, lissafa abin da neuron ɗin zai fitar da hannu, kuna samun amsa daidai kowane lokaci, har da lokacin da ReLU ya ba da 0
Idan aka ba ku rahoton horarwa mai loss da accuracy, bayanin yadda horarwa ke canja weights da gane alamun overfitting, kuna amfani da kalmomin loss, learning rate, epoch da validation daidai
A Google Colab da Keras, loda lambobin MNIST, daidaita pixels da nuna hoto ɗaya tare da lakabinsa, pixels suna tsakanin 0 da 1, kuma lakabin ya yi daidai da hoton

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Yadda neural networks ke aiki

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Mene ne deep learning
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 4
Manufa: Bayyana deep learning da kalmominku, ku kuma faɗi inda ake amfani da shi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ba tare da rubutattun bayanai ba, za ku iya bayanin mene ne deep learning da ambaton irin bayanan da ya fi aiki da su, kuna ambaton layers da ke koyon tsari daga misalai, da aƙalla irin bayanai biyu da suka dace.
Deep learning wani nau'in machine learning ne da ke amfani da neural networks: ƙananan sassan lissafi masu yawa, da ake kira neurons, da aka haɗa su a layuka (layers). "Deep" (zurfi) yana nufin akwai layers masu yawa. Kowane layer yana neman tsari a cikin abin da layer na gabansa ya fitar.
A hoto, layers na farko suna lura da abubuwa masu sauƙi kamar gefuna (edges), na tsakiya suna lura da siffofi, na ƙarshe kuma suna lura da abu gaba ɗaya kamar fuska ko lamba. Ba wanda ya rubuta waɗannan dokoki: network ɗin yana koyon su daga misalai masu yawa da aka sa wa lakabi.
Ya fi aiki idan akwai bayanai masu yawa, kuma bayanan suna da yawa da rikitarwa: hotuna, sauti, magana da dogon rubutu. Yana buƙatar bayanai da ƙarfin kwamfuta fiye da models masu sauƙi, shi ya sa ya yi tashe bayan manyan tarin bayanai da ƙwayoyin zane masu sauri (GPUs) suka zama ruwan dare.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Deep learning: machine learning da ke amfani da neural networks masu layers da yawa.
- Neural network: model da aka yi da ƙananan sassa masu yawa (neurons) da aka haɗa a layers.
- Layer: rukunin neurons da dukansu ke karɓar bayani daga layer na gabansu.
- GPU: ƙwayar zane (graphics chip) da ke yin lissafi da yawa a lokaci ɗaya, ana amfani da ita don horar da networks da sauri.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta kayan aiki huɗu da kuka yi amfani da su da wataƙila suke amfani da deep learning (misali buɗe waya da fuska, rubutu da murya, neman hoto, fassara). Ga kowanne, ku rubuta irin bayanan da yake koya daga ciki: hotuna, sauti ko rubutu.
Yanzu za ku iya bayanin mene ne deep learning, dalilin da yasa yake amfani da layers, da inda ake amfani da shi.

check.q: Mene ne neurons a cikin neural network?
options: Ƙwayoyin ƙwaƙwalwa da aka kwafa cikin kwamfuta
Ƙananan sassan lissafi da aka haɗa a layers
Hotunan da aka sa wa lakabi
check.why: Neural network an yi shi ne da ƙananan sassan lissafi masu yawa, da ake kira neurons, a layers.

check.q: Rundunarku tana son ta rarraba dubban saƙonnin rediyo da aka naɗa bisa ga wanda ya yi magana. Za ku yi tunanin deep learning?
options: Eh; ya fi aiki da bayanai masu yawa da rikitarwa kamar sauti
A'a; deep learning ba ya iya amfani da sauti
A'a; yana aiki ne kawai da lambobi a tebur
Sai dai idan naɗaɗɗun ba su kai goma ba
check.why: Deep learning ya fi aiki da bayanai masu yawa da rikitarwa kamar hotuna, sauti da rubutu.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Cikin neuron: weights, bias da activation
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Lissafa da hannu abin da neuron ɗaya ke fitarwa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku inputs, weights, bias da ReLU na neuron, za ku iya lissafa abin da neuron ɗin zai fitar da hannu, kuna samun amsa daidai kowane lokaci, har da lokacin da ReLU ya ba da 0.
Neuron yana karɓar wasu lambobi, yana ninka kowanne da weight (nauyi), yana haɗa su, sannan ya ƙara wata lamba guda da ake kira bias. Weights suna faɗin muhimmancin kowane input; network ɗin ne ke koyon su.
Sannan yana amfani da activation function, wanda ke yanke abin da zai wuce gaba. Wanda aka fi amfani da shi, ReLU, mai sauƙi ne: idan jimlar ta yi ƙasa da sifili, ya fitar da 0; in ba haka ba, ya fitar da jimlar.
Misali: inputs 2 da 3, weights 0.5 da -1, bias 1. Jimla = 2 x 0.5 + 3 x (-1) + 1 = 1 - 3 + 1 = -1. ReLU yana mayar da -1 zuwa 0, don haka wannan neuron yana fitar da 0. Idan inputs 2 da 1 ne a maimakon haka: 1 - 1 + 1 = 1, don haka yana fitar da 1.
Network yana da dubban irin waɗannan. Layer na ƙarshe sau da yawa yana amfani da softmax, wanda ke mayar da abin da ya fitar zuwa damarmaki (chances) da jimlarsu ta kai kashi 100, ɗaya ga kowace amsa mai yiwuwa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku ninka kowane input da weight ɗinsa.
- Ku haɗa sakamakon gaba ɗaya.
- Ku ƙara bias.
- Ku yi amfani da activation: da ReLU, lambar ƙasa da sifili ta zama 0.
- Wannan lambar ita ce abin da neuron ke fitarwa.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Neuron: ƙaramin sashe da ke ninka inputs da weights, ya ƙara bias, sannan ya yi amfani da activation.
- Weight: lambar da network ke koyo wadda ke faɗin muhimmancin input.
- Bias: ƙarin lamba da ake ƙarawa a jimla, ita ma ana koyon ta.
- Activation function: dokar da ke yanke abin da neuron zai wuce da shi gaba.
- ReLU: wani activation: jimlar da ke ƙasa da sifili ta zama 0, sauran kuma su zauna yadda suke.
- Softmax: yana mayar da abin da layer na ƙarshe ya fitar zuwa damarmaki da jimlarsu ta kai 1.
Gwada yanzu: Ku lissafa abin da neuron zai fitar da hannu: inputs 4 da 1, weights 0.5 da 2, bias -3, activation ReLU. Sannan ku canja bias zuwa -6 ku sake lissafawa. (Amsoshi: 1, sannan 0.)
Yanzu za ku iya lissafa abin da neuron ke fitarwa daga inputs, weights, bias da activation ɗinsa.

check.q: A cikin neuron, mene ne bias?
options: Dokar da ke cewa model ɗin ba shi da adalci
Ƙarin lamba ɗaya da ake ƙarawa bayan an haɗa inputs da aka ninka da weights
check.why: Neuron yana ƙara bias a jimlar inputs da weights kafin activation.

check.q: Inputs 4 da 1, weights 0.5 da 2, bias -1, ReLU. Wace amsa za ku samu?
check.why: 4 x 0.5 + 1 x 2 - 1 = 3, kuma ReLU yana barin jimlar da ta wuce sifili.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Yadda network ke koyo: loss, epochs da ƙananan matakai
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Bayyana yadda horarwa ke canja weights don rage kurakurai.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku rahoton horarwa mai loss da accuracy, za ku iya bayanin yadda horarwa ke canja weights da gane alamun overfitting, kuna amfani da kalmomin loss, learning rate, epoch da validation daidai.
A farko, weights ba su da tsari (random), don haka hasashen network ɗin ba shi da kyau. Horarwa ce ke gyara hakan. Network yana yin hasashe, sannan loss function yana auna yawan kuskurensa: babban loss yana nufin kuskure mai yawa, ƙaramin loss yana nufin ya kusa.
Sannan yana gano, ga kowane weight, wace hanya ce za ta rage loss (wannan mataki ana kiransa backpropagation), sannan ya matsar da kowane weight ɗan mataki ta wannan hanya (gradient descent). Girman matakin shi ne learning rate: idan ya yi girma sosai, yana wuce wurin; idan ya yi ƙanƙanta sosai, yana tafiya a hankali sosai.
Zagaye ɗaya a cikin dukkan misalan horarwa shi ne epoch. Horarwa yawanci tana ɗaukar epochs da yawa. Kuna kallon loss yana raguwa, accuracy yana ƙaruwa, kuma kuna duba validation set (bayanan da aka ware daga horarwa) don kama overfitting: idan accuracy na horarwa yana ci gaba da hawa amma na validation yana sauka, ku tsaya.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku fara da weights marasa tsari (random).
- Ku yi hasashe a kan misalan horarwa.
- Ku auna kuskure da loss function.
- Ku matsar da kowane weight ɗan mataki don rage loss.
- Ku maimaita na epochs da yawa, kuna kallon accuracy na validation.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Loss: lambar da ke auna yawan kuskuren hasashen network.
- Backpropagation: gano yadda kowane weight ya shafi loss.
- Gradient descent: matsar da weights a ƙananan matakai don rage loss.
- Learning rate: girman kowane mataki.
- Epoch: zagaye ɗaya cikakke a cikin bayanan horarwa.
- Validation set: bayanan da aka ware lokacin horarwa don duba overfitting.
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi wasan "gane lambar" da aboki ko ku kaɗai: ku zaɓi lambar ɓoye daga 1 zuwa 100, ku yi hasashe, ku sami amsar "ta yi yawa" ko "ta yi kaɗan", sannan ku canja hasashenku da ƙaramin mataki kowane lokaci. Ku rubuta wane sashe na wasan yake kama da loss, wanne yake kama da learning rate, da zagaye nawa (epochs) aka ɗauka.
Yanzu za ku iya bayanin loss, backpropagation, gradient descent, learning rate, epochs da overfitting da kalmomi masu sauƙi.

options: Yawan hotunan da ke cikin tarin bayanai
Girman kowane mataki da weights ke matsawa
check.why: Mataki mai girma sosai yana wuce wurin; mataki ƙarami sosai yana tafiya a hankali sosai.

check.q: Bayan epoch 4, accuracy na validation ya fara sauka yayin da accuracy na horarwa ke ci gaba da hawa. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku tsayar da horarwa; model ɗin ya fara overfitting
check.why: Saukar accuracy na validation tare da hawan accuracy na horarwa alamar overfitting ce.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Gina neural network a Colab

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Lodawa da shirya bayanan hotuna
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Loda lambobin MNIST a Colab, ku daidaita su, ku kalli hoto ɗaya.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A Google Colab da Keras, za ku iya loda lambobin MNIST, daidaita pixels da nuna hoto ɗaya tare da lakabinsa, pixels suna tsakanin 0 da 1, kuma lakabin ya yi daidai da hoton.
MNIST sanannen tarin bayanai ne na atisaye: ƙananan hotuna 70,000 na lambobi 0 zuwa 9 da aka rubuta da hannu, kowanne pixels 28 da 28, tare da ainihin lambar a matsayin lakabi. Keras, ɗakin lambobi (library) na deep learning kyauta da ke aiki a Google Colab, zai iya loda shi da layi ɗaya, an riga an raba shi zuwa hotunan horarwa 60,000 da na gwaji 10,000.
Kowane pixel lamba ce daga 0 (baƙi) zuwa 255 (fari). Networks suna koyo da kyau da ƙananan lambobi, don haka kuna daidaita su zuwa tsakanin 0 da 1 ta raba su da 255. Ana kiran wannan normalizing.
Ku kalli bayananku kafin horarwa. matplotlib, ɗakin lambobi na zane, zai iya zana hoto ɗaya don ku duba cewa lakabin ya yi daidai da hoton.
Mataki-mataki:
- A sabon notebook na Colab ku gudanar da: import keras
- Loda: (x_train, y_train), (x_test, y_test) = keras.datasets.mnist.load_data()
- Daidaita: x_train = x_train / 255.0 da x_test = x_test / 255.0
- Duba girma: print(x_train.shape, x_test.shape)
- Zana ɗaya: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.imshow(x_train[0], cmap="gray"); plt.show(); print(y_train[0])
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- MNIST: tarin bayanai na atisaye mai hotuna 70,000 na lambobin da aka rubuta da hannu.
- Keras: ɗakin lambobi (library) na Python kyauta, mai sauƙi ga masu farawa, don gina neural networks.
- Pixel: ɗigo ɗaya na hoto, da aka ajiye a matsayin lamba.
- Normalizing: daidaita lambobi zuwa ƙaramin zango kamar 0 zuwa 1 don horarwa ta fi aiki.
- matplotlib: ɗakin lambobi na Python don zana jadawali da hotuna.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Keras code example: Simple MNIST convnet
- Google Colab: Frequently Asked Questions
Gwada yanzu: Ku loda ku daidaita MNIST a Colab. Ku buga girman tarin horarwa da na gwaji. Ku zana hotunan da ke matsayi 0, 1 da 2, ku buga lakabinsu don duba ko sun yi daidai.
Yanzu za ku iya loda tarin hotuna, daidaita shi (normalize) da duba shi da ido.

check.q: Me normalizing pixels na MNIST ke nufi a nan?
options: Daidaita su zuwa tsakanin 0 da 1 ta raba su da 255
Juya hotunan sama ya koma ƙasa
check.why: Raba da 255 yana mayar da 0 zuwa 255 zuwa 0 zuwa 1, wanda ke taimaka wa koyo.

check.q: Kun loda MNIST kuma kuna son ku tabbata lakabin daidai ne. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku fara horarwa ku duba daga baya
Ku zana hoto ɗaya da matplotlib ku duba ko ya yi daidai da lakabinsa
check.why: Ku kalli bayananku kafin horarwa don duba ko lakabin ya yi daidai da hoton.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Ginawa da horar da network
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Gina network na Keras, ku yi compile, ku horar da shi na epochs kaɗan.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku bayanan MNIST da aka shirya, za ku iya gina, compile da horar da neural network na Keras, code ɗin yana aiki, an yi amfani da validation split, kuma loss yana raguwa a kowane epoch.
Sequential model tari ne na layers. Namu: keras.Input(shape=(28, 28)) yana faɗin abin da ke shiga. layers.Flatten() yana mayar da kowane hoto na 28 x 28 zuwa layi ɗaya na lambobi 784. layers.Dense(128, activation="relu") layer ne na neurons 128. layers.Dense(10, activation="softmax") shi ne mai fitarwa: dama ɗaya ga kowace lamba daga 0 zuwa 9.
compile yana saita yadda yake koyo: optimizer="adam" (sanannen nau'in gradient descent), loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy" (loss da ya dace idan lakabi lambobi ne kawai kamar 7), da metrics=["accuracy"] don ku ga sau nawa yake daidai.
fit yana horar da shi: model.fit(x_train, y_train, epochs=5, validation_split=0.1). validation_split=0.1 yana ware kashi 10 na bayanan horarwa don duba overfitting. Kowane epoch yana buga loss, accuracy, val_loss da val_accuracy. Ku kalli loss yana raguwa.
Mataki-mataki:
- from keras import layers
- model = keras.Sequential([keras.Input(shape=(28, 28)), layers.Flatten(), layers.Dense(128, activation="relu"), layers.Dense(10, activation="softmax")])
- model.compile(optimizer="adam", loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy", metrics=["accuracy"])
- model.summary() don ganin layers.
- model.fit(x_train, y_train, epochs=5, validation_split=0.1)
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Sequential model: network da aka yi da layers da aka jera ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
- Flatten: layer da ke mayar da tebur na pixels zuwa dogon layi ɗaya.
- Dense layer: layer da kowane neuron ɗinsa ke haɗe da kowane input.
- Optimizer: hanyar da ke sabunta weights; adam sananne ne.
- compile: yana saita optimizer, loss da metrics kafin horarwa.
- validation_split: rabon bayanan horarwa da aka ware don duba overfitting.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Keras code example: Simple MNIST convnet
Gwada yanzu: Ku gina, ku yi compile, ku horar da network na epochs 5. Ku rubuta accuracy da val_accuracy bayan epoch 1 da bayan epoch 5. Dukansu sun hau?
Yanzu za ku iya gina neural network a Keras, yin compile da horar da shi yayin da kuke lura da overfitting.

check.q: Mene ne Sequential model a Keras?
check.why: Sequential yana jera layers bi da bi daga input zuwa output.

check.q: Kuna son ku gani lokacin horarwa ko model ɗin ya fara overfitting. Me za ku ƙara a fit?
check.why: validation_split yana ware wasu bayanan horarwa don duba model ɗin a kowane epoch.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Gwaji, hasashe da ingantawa
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Auna accuracy na gwaji, ku yi hasashen hotuna na gaske, ku gwada ingantawa ɗaya, ku faɗi iyakokin model ɗin.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku network da aka horar, za ku iya auna daidaitonsa a gwaji, hasashen sababbin hotuna, gwada canji ɗaya da bayanin iyakokinsa, kuna canja abu ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya, kuma kuna ambaton aƙalla iyaka ɗaya ta gaske.
Gwaji na gaskiya shi ne bayanan da network bai taɓa gani ba: model.evaluate(x_test, y_test) yana buga loss da accuracy na gwaji. Ƙaramin network kamar namu yawanci yana samun sama da kashi 90 sosai a MNIST.
Don hasashe, ku ba shi hotuna: probs = model.predict(x_test[:5]) yana ba da damarmaki 10 ga kowane hoto. probs.argmax(axis=1) yana zaɓar lambar da ke da dama mafi girma. Ku kwatanta waɗannan da y_test[:5].
Don inganta shi, ku canja abu ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya ku sake gwadawa: ƙarin neurons (Dense(256)), ƙarin epochs, ko convolutional network (layers da ke bincika ƙananan sassan hoto), wanda ke kaiwa kusan kashi 99 a misalin Keras na hukuma.
Ku san iyakokinsa: yana sanin lambobi guda ɗaya da ke tsakiya kamar MNIST kawai. Hoton alamar titi ko harafi zai sami lamba duk da haka. A aiki na gaske, kamar karanta fom ko duba kayayyaki, mutum yana duba sakamakon da model ɗin bai da tabbaci a kai, kuma ana gwada model ɗin da bayanai daga ainihin wurin da za a yi amfani da shi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku gudanar da model.evaluate(x_test, y_test) ku rubuta accuracy na gwaji.
- probs = model.predict(x_test[:5])
- print(probs.argmax(axis=1), y_test[:5]) don kwatanta hasashe da gaskiya.
- Ku canja abu ɗaya (neurons ko epochs), ku sake gini, horarwa da aunawa.
- Ku rubuta ko ya taimaka da iyaka ɗaya.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- evaluate: yana gwada model da aka horar a kan bayanai kuma yana faɗin loss da accuracy.
- argmax: yana zaɓar matsayin lamba mafi girma: a nan, lambar da ta fi yiwuwa.
- Convolutional network (CNN): network mai layers da ke bincika ƙananan sassan hoto; yana da kyau sosai wajen hotuna.
- Hyperparameter: saitin da ku kuka zaɓa, kamar neurons ko epochs, ba wanda network ke koyo ba.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Keras code example: Simple MNIST convnet
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku auna network ɗinku a kan tarin gwaji, ku yi hasashen hotunan gwaji biyar na farko ku kwatanta da ainihin lakabinsu, sannan ku canja Dense(128) zuwa Dense(256) ko epochs zuwa 10, ku sake horarwa ku sake aunawa. Ku rubuta jimloli biyu: canjin ya taimaka, kuma mece ce iyaka ɗaya ta wannan model?
Yanzu za ku iya horarwa, gwadawa, amfani da inganta neural network, da bayanin inda za a amince da shi da inda ba za a amince ba.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce An shirya bayanai Ba a loda MNIST ba, ko ba a daidaita pixels ba. An loda MNIST kuma an daidaita pixels tsakanin 0 da 1. An zana hoto ɗaya kuma an duba shi da lakabinsa. An gina kuma an horar da network Model ɗin ba ya yin compile ko horarwa. Network na Keras mai Flatten, Dense hidden layer da output na softmax mai neurons 10 yana horarwa da validation split. Ya rubuta yadda loss da accuracy na validation suka canja a kowane epoch. Accuracy na gwaji da hasashe Babu accuracy na gwaji, ko ba a kwatanta hasashe da ainihin lakabi ba. Ya faɗi accuracy na gwaji kuma ya kwatanta hasashe biyar da ainihin lakabinsu. Ya kuma duba hasashe ɗaya da ba daidai ba, ya kuma ba da shawarar dalilin da yasa ya faru. An gwada canji ɗaya Ba a yi canji ba, ko an canja abubuwa da yawa lokaci ɗaya. Canji ɗaya (ƙarin neurons ko ƙarin epochs), an sake horarwa, tare da jimla kan ko ya taimaka. Ya kuma duba canjin don alamun overfitting. Iyakoki Ba a ambaci iyaka ba, ko iyakar ba daidai ba ce. Iyaka ɗaya ta gaske, kamar sanin lambobi guda ɗaya da ke tsakiya kawai. Ya kuma faɗi yadda mutum zai duba sakamakon da ba a da tabbaci a kai a aiki na gaske. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

options: Damarmaki 10 ga kowane hoto cikin hotuna 5
check.why: predict yana mayar da dama ga kowace lamba a kowane hoto; argmax yana zaɓar wadda ta fi yiwuwa.

check.q: Kuna son ku sani ko ƙarin epochs suna taimakawa. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku canja epochs, neurons da layers duka lokaci ɗaya
Ku yanke hukunci da accuracy na horarwa kawai
Ku tsallake tarin gwaji wannan karon
Ku canja yawan epochs kawai, ku sake horarwa ku kwatanta accuracy na gwaji
check.why: Ku canja abu ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya don ku san abin da ya kawo bambancin.
